name: Trouble at the Docks
summary: In Ratchet, a stolen bottle puts Bigglefuzz's job at risk. Mad Magglish fled inland with a 99-Year-Old Port, a gift from Baron Revilgaz to Gazlowe, and now hides in the Wailing Caverns.

sections.title: A Clumsy Mishap
sections.body: Ratchet's docks carry sea trade with Booty Bay across the Great Sea. One morning, a huge shipment arrived, and Crane Operator Bigglefuzz overloaded his crane to unload it faster. The crane dropped the whole load across the docks. In the confusion, Mad Magglish, a local nuisance, snatched a valuable bottle of liquor and fled inland.

sections.title: Diplomatic Vintage
sections.body: The bottle is a 99-Year-Old Port, a personal diplomatic gift from Baron Revilgaz, Booty Bay's ruler, to Gazlowe, Ratchet's chief engineer and overseer. Its loss could humiliate Bigglefuzz and anger both trade leaders. Fearing for his job or worse, Bigglefuzz followed the thief to the mouth of the Wailing Caverns. But fear stopped him from going inside.

sections.title: The Cavern Hideout
sections.body: Mad Magglish hides in damp natural tunnels outside the Wailing Caverns' inner gateway, not deep in the corrupted dreamscape. The thief relies on clumsy stealth and dark alcoves, hoping pursuers will give up. Find Magglish in the outer caverns before the port is uncorked or destroyed.

faq.q: Why is this bottle of port so important?
faq.answer: The 99-Year-Old Port is a lavish personal gift from Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay to Gazlowe, Ratchet's boss. Losing it could anger Ratchet's leadership and cost Crane Operator Bigglefuzz his livelihood.

Mad Magglish is a thief and troublemaker who hangs around Ratchet. When Bigglefuzz dropped a huge cargo load on the docks, Magglish grabbed the rare port and fled to hide in the nearby Wailing Caverns.

faq.q: Do I have to enter the Wailing Caverns dungeon to find the thief?
faq.answer: No. Mad Magglish hides in the winding cave passages outside the instance portal, using poor stealth in the upper side tunnels or near the flooded chambers by the main entrance.

faq.q: How did the cargo spill happen?
faq.answer: A huge cargo shipment arrived from Booty Bay, and Crane Operator Bigglefuzz tried to unload more crates at once than his equipment could handle. The overloaded crane dropped the load across Ratchet's docks.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Ratchet and Booty Bay?
faq.answer: Ratchet and Booty Bay are Steamwheedle Cartel port towns, joined by commerce and privateer fleets. Regular shipments and formal courtesies pass between Baron Revilgaz in the south and Gazlowe in the Barrens, sustaining their shared trade empire.

faq.q: Why didn't Bigglefuzz retrieve the bottle himself?
aliases: why didn't the goblin get it
faq.answer: Bigglefuzz followed the thief to the Wailing Caverns' entrance, but the underground labyrinth's eerie reputation and monstrous inhabitants frightened him into stopping at the threshold.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can spot Mad Magglish's careless concealment in the cavern crannies, where the thief uses rudimentary stealth to escape notice.
As a member of the Horde, you help Ratchet's dockhands keep the primary neutral port between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms running smoothly.
As a member of the Alliance, you travel deep in the Horde-dominated Barrens, where good relations with Steamwheedle port operators help ensure safe passage through neutral waters.
